N1-binding-names-other-bytes-of-A1.what: the binding names A1 by the digest of other bytes of the same content (re-serialised with spaces); the byte scope is the attachment as issued

N2-binding-absent-on-one-context.what: the second approver's context carries no authorization_binding: a mixture of bound and unbound contexts (section 6.1)

N3-binding-names-another-specification.what: the binding names the digest of another version of the specification (amount 12551) than the one the person approved

N4-mapping-not-lossless.what: the EP Action Object carries a parameter the specification does not (a memo): the contexts are signed over it, the mapping is not lossless

N5-action-hash-not-recomputed.what: the bundle's action_hash is not the SHA-256 of the canonical Action Object it carries

N6-receipt-changed-after-its-digest.what: the Trust Receipt is changed after the later attachment took its digest (log_proof leaf_index 0 -> 1)

N7-reverse-reference-in-the-named-attach.what: the receipt reference is carried in A1, the attachment the binding names: circular; A1 is re-sealed after the binding was signed

N8-signoff-by-a-key-outside-the-pinned-s.what: the second signoff is made with a key the relying party did not pin

N9-dps-approval-signature-broken.what: the person's approval signature in the DPS signatures attachment does not verify: the binding names a source that fails native verification

N10-dps-trust-inputs-not-held.what: the relying party holds no DPS trust inputs: the binding cannot be derived, the result is INDETERMINATE, never SATISFIED

N11-execution-of-another-specification.what: the later attachment's request and attempt carry another specification's digest than the one approved

N12-context-without-ep_version.what: every Authorization Context is issued without ep_version and signed validly over the rest: refused by the schema controls of section 4 before anything is read (Iman Schrock, 4 November 2026), never SATISFIED

N13-context-without-context_type.what: every Authorization Context is issued without context_type and signed validly over the rest: refused by the schema controls of section 4 before anything is read (Iman Schrock, 4 November 2026), never SATISFIED

N14-context-without-policy_id.what: every Authorization Context is issued without policy_id and signed validly over the rest: refused by the schema controls of section 4 before anything is read (Iman Schrock, 4 November 2026), never SATISFIED

N15-context-without-initiator.what: every Authorization Context is issued without initiator and signed validly over the rest: refused by the schema controls of section 4 before anything is read (Iman Schrock, 4 November 2026), never SATISFIED

N16-context-without-approver_index.what: every Authorization Context is issued without approver_index and signed validly over the rest: refused by the schema controls of section 4 before anything is read (Iman Schrock, 4 November 2026), never SATISFIED

N17-action-without-policy_id-and-request.what: the Action Object carries only action_type, initiator, parameters, ep_version and target, as the pinned vector's does: section 3's minimum is not met, refused by the schema controls (the author: the minimum applies)

N18-action-policy_id-made-up.what: the Action Object's policy_id is a value made up to fill the shape, carried consistently into the contexts, not the relying party's pinned EP policy identifier: caught at step 10 against the pinned policy (and the binding then differs)

N19-action-requested_at-not-the-proposal.what: the Action Object's requested_at is not the time of A1's proposal stage (the explicit input the profile derives it from)
